extDescription.message: Canvas, WebGL, audio and ClientRects noise on every site, before its first line, with the same values on a site at every visit. From the Noor browser.

siteOff.message: Off on this site: it sees the real values

notWeb.message: This page isn’t a website: there’s nothing to protect here.

webGLHint.message: 3D drawing, as the graphics card renders it

audioHint.message: Sound as the computer processes it. Off at first: on a PC these values are nearly the same for everyone, so noise in them tells the browser apart.

clientRectsHint.message: The sizes of what a page shows. Off at first, for the same reason as audio.

note.message: Each site sees values of its own, the same at every visit. A change applies as the page reloads.

changed.message: Done. The page reloaded with it.

dir.description: The direction of these messages' language: ltr or rtl.
